pages.text: You've devised a way to afflict your Phantom servants with insomnia. With just a few cocoa beans, you can alter the nature of the Phantasm Focus, allowing you to summon a close relative of the Phantom servant: the Flare servant.

For reasons unknown, the Void Staff resonates particularly well with the Flare Focus, enabling you to summon more Flare servants.Casting with a Void Staff while wearing the Void Set also causes your Flare servants' attacks to inflict Void Touched.
